_meta.geography: Los Angeles County, California (incorporated cities + unincorporated)
_meta.notes: User-provided baseline values are taken as authoritative anchors. Source labels indicate the canonical dataset; specific URLs and microdata files are not fetched. Mark any value with SOURCE_NEEDED if not directly substantiated by a public release.

evidence_legend.strong: directly observed in published government dataset within last 3 years
evidence_legend.medium: published but with methodological caveats or older vintage
evidence_legend.weak: literature consensus but wide range of estimates

building_permits_2024.source: Census Building Permits Survey / HCD APR cross-check

occupancy_rate_assumed.source: model assumption: physical occupancy after lease-up of new units

annual_demolition_loss_rate.source: California HCD APR loss data; LA-specific estimate

persons_per_household_floor.source: model assumption: minimum household size as crowding eases

persons_per_household_ceiling.source: model assumption: +0.40 over baseline before severe crowding

estimated_population_2024.source: derived: households * persons_per_household; aligns with CA DOF E-1 2024 estimate range

peer_metro_rent_anchor.source: weighted average of national large-metro median rent ex-coastal-CA, ACS-derived

latent_demand_elasticity_mu.source: model parameter; bracketed 0.10-0.30. Hsieh-Moretti 2019 implied migration suppression

real_wage_drift_annual.source: long-run US real wage growth, BLS

estimated_unsheltered_population_la_coun.source: LAHSA 2024 Greater LA Homeless Count (countywide unsheltered + sheltered ~75k)

cost_per_unsheltered_person_year_central.source: Flaming/Toros LA Economic Roundtable / HUD HMIS midrange

cost_per_unsheltered_person_year_high.source: Flaming/Toros LA Economic Roundtable (high end, includes ER, jail, EMS)

hpi_baseline.source: model index, dimensionless 0-100, anchored to 2024 conditions

rent_to_income.source: Colburn & Aldern 2022 (Homelessness is a Housing Problem) - rent level dominates

eli_supply.source: extremely-low-income housing availability, Glaeser et al.

eli_share_of_new_units_baseline.source: HCD APR / LIHTC pipeline LA share

property_tax_rate.source: Prop 13 base 1% + LA County avg overrides (school bonds, etc.)

la_share_post_eraf.source: LA County share of 1% general levy after ERAF redirect

sales_tax_rate_combined.source: LA County combined state+local sales tax

sales_tax_local_share_of_combined.source: 1% Bradley-Burns local + ~0.5% Measure LA-area district avg of 9.75%

construction_materials_taxable_per_unit.source: ULI 2023 LA infill cost study (materials portion)

service_cost_per_capita_annual.source: marginal LA County local services per new resident; lower than average general-fund per-capita because schools (state-funded), much of police/fire/parks is fixed cost

income_tax_state_marginal_for_growth.source: CA effective marginal on incremental household income, FTB

income_tax_share_returned_to_la_infrastr.source: weak share via state grants, transit, etc.

construction_labor_capacity_growth_cap_p.source: rolling 3-yr completions x 1.40 max; building trades labor pool elasticity

construction_cost_per_unit_baseline_usd.source: ULI 2023 LA County midrise infill all-in

ladwp_baseline_interconnection_lag_month.source: SOURCE_NEEDED - LADWP queue tracking is opaque; estimate from developer surveys

transformer_lead_time_months_baseline.source: SOURCE_NEEDED - distribution transformer procurement lead time post-2022

utility_cost_per_new_connection_usd.source: marginal distribution upgrade per multifamily unit

utility_capacity_max_multiplier.source: model cap to prevent runaway feedback

elasticities.rent_to_supply_alpha_source: Hsieh-Moretti 2019 implied ~-0.25; Anenberg-Kung 2014 JUE submarket -0.40 to -0.50; Baum-Snow & Han 2024 metro ~-0.20
elasticities.rent_to_income_beta_source: Saiz 2010 region; long-run income pass-through to rent
elasticities.income_composition_lambda_source: model parameter; share of moderate-income inflow that pulls median down
